changed_line_groups.trigger: A patch contains a binary summary but its exact metadata names no supported source file, such as an image-only change.
changed_line_groups.evidence: Current binary tests change a PNG alongside a binary-marked Python file, so supported source always exists. The no-extra-process test restores the PNG and therefore skips metadata selection entirely.
changed_line_groups.disposition: Normal behavior is implemented but the binary-only return is unmeasured on both hosts. A staged/source-patch test containing only a true binary should assert empty changed source ranges and no forced text patch.

changed_line_groups.trigger: Nonempty Git history output contains no owned timestamp header.
changed_line_groups.evidence: file_log_patches fixes the header format and reports process failure before parsing. Valid successful output contains headers or is empty. Malformed launcher output can still reach this refusal.
changed_line_groups.disposition: No missing valid-history behavior. A corrupt-output seam check can cover refusal; do not call the guard globally unreachable or remove it based on this report.

changed_line_groups.trigger: A replay, target or pool path resolves lexically outside its expected workspace.
changed_line_groups.evidence: Normal CLI targets come from the analyzed Git corpus and pool paths are generated under the root. The public run_mutants Python entry still accepts supplied mutant paths, so malformed callers can reach the guard.
changed_line_groups.disposition: Link and hardlink cases do not exercise lexical escape. A mutation entry test with an escaping target should assert refusal before snapshot/replay. No outside write is observed in the retained measurements.

changed_line_groups.trigger: The owner request to remove a completed or interrupted command fails; fallback must kill/reap the tree before propagating that error.
changed_line_groups.evidence: Normal lifecycle, timeout, interruption and Job-stop tests cover cleanup through a functioning owner. They do not drive the parent remove-request failure path in the retained full reports.
changed_line_groups.disposition: This shared failure path protects output ownership and remains a material verification gap if the final reports still miss it. Inject owner removal failure around a real registered command and assert reaping plus lock release before the error returns.

changed_line_groups.trigger: Direct Python caller parses one exported scored row.
changed_line_groups.evidence: Repository-wide source/test search finds its definition but no caller. Public CLI and current regression tests use parse_scored_tsv, whose decode_record and _scored_parts path is measured.
changed_line_groups.disposition: No missing CLI export/import path. parse_scored_row is a retained named public API, and its direct-call compatibility remains required. Ordinary and encoded single-row calls are unmeasured in these full artifacts; no evidence shows wrong behavior.

changed_line_groups.trigger: A headerless scored record has neither 16 nor 17 fields, or a direct single-row parse supplies that width.
changed_line_groups.evidence: Header-bearing wrong-width input refuses earlier in _scored_line. Headerless input reaches this guard, so it is reachable through the bulk parser as well as the unused single-row function.
changed_line_groups.disposition: The refusal exists but its headerless compatibility case is unmeasured. Add an invalid-width headerless export/import test; this is separate from delimiter and marked-format admission.
